meta.timeModelNote: Every *MinutesAgo / *DaysAgo field is an offset from the moment the app loads, so this snapshot never goes stale. The app converts them to absolute ISO timestamps in memory and stores volunteer actions as absolute ISO timestamps.
meta.needsHelpRule: needsHelp = food or water is past the species "okHours" threshold, or health is "treatment" or "critical".

stations.name: Station #01 - Riverside
stations.notes: Two dry bowls and one raised water trough.

stations.name: Station #02 - North Green
stations.notes: Behind the gate so dogs cannot knock it over.

stations.name: Station #03 - Market Alley
stations.notes: Wet food only - dry food attracts rats to the stalls.

stations.name: Station #05 - South Basin
stations.notes: Water only. Otis and Moose rely on this one.

stations.name: Station #06 - Old Bandstand
stations.notes: Dry food plus a water cooler for the meadow dogs.

animals.name: Milo
animals.description: Friendly ginger with white mittens who sleeps on the warm bench cushions.
animals.notes: Follows you to the kiosk if you shake a treat bag. Prefers wet food in cold weather.

animals.name: Luna
animals.color: Tuxedo black with a white bib
animals.description: Shy tuxedo girl who watches the duck pond from the old stone wall.
animals.notes: Only comes out after dusk. Leave the bowl on the wall, never on the grass.

location.label: Stone wall by the duck pond

animals.name: Clementine
animals.color: Calico with a notch in her left ear
animals.description: Senior calico who lived at the market long before anyone kept records.
animals.notes: Needs soft food and a warm crate below 8 degrees. Kindest cat on the block.

animals.name: Pepper
animals.description: Confident jet-black cat who patrols the community garden rows.
animals.notes: Loves feather toys. Will trade headbutts for food.

animals.name: Biscuit
animals.description: Young tabby who follows the school run and asks every child for a snack.
animals.notes: Very busy between 08:00 and 09:00. Feed on the library steps only.

animals.name: Mochi
animals.color: Seal point with bright blue eyes
animals.description: Talkative seal-point mix who announces every walker on the riverside path.
animals.notes: Chatty. One scoop is enough - two other volunteers already feed him.

animals.name: Sable
animals.color: Solid black, one white whisker patch
animals.description: Quiet black cat sheltering under the canal bridge arches.
animals.notes: Dehydrates fast in dry weather - check the water bowl twice a day.

animals.name: Nutmeg
animals.color: Brown tabby with a raccoon-striped tail
animals.description: Bold tabby who has claimed the boathouse roof as her sunbed.
animals.notes: Climbs the fishing netting to reach the roof. Do not startle her up high.

animals.name: Tiger
animals.description: Big orange tom limping since Friday - injured front left leg, needs a vet check.
animals.notes: Do not handle the leg. Trap appointment booked, keep him calm and fed in the meantime.

animals.name: Hazel
animals.description: Gentle grey-and-white girl who waits by the north gate every morning.
animals.notes: Polite. Sits and waits instead of meowing.

animals.name: Olive
animals.description: Elegant grey cat who keeps to the long grass at the east meadow edge.
animals.notes: Rarely seen before noon.

animals.name: Dusty
animals.description: Shaggy senior longhair who naps in the wheelbarrow by the tool shed.
animals.notes: Coat needs brushing - he tolerates it after food.

animals.name: Jasmine
animals.description: Bright white cat with ginger patches who owns the hilltop steps.
animals.notes: Comes running when you call her name.

animals.name: Pixel
animals.color: Steel grey tabby with a kinked tail
animals.description: Skittish young tabby living behind the old bandstand, always hungry.
animals.notes: Bolts if two people approach at once. Feed alone and step back.

animals.name: Waffle
animals.description: Cheerful orange boy who greets the ferry crowds at the landing.
animals.notes: Watch the crowds - he naps right on the gangway.

animals.name: Clover
animals.description: Tortoiseshell who guards the compost corner of the community garden.
animals.notes: Hisses at dogs but never at people.

animals.name: Marmalade
animals.description: Enormous marmalade tom who holds court outside the bakery.
animals.notes: Friendly but heavy - do not pick him up.

animals.name: Shadow
animals.description: Nocturnal black cat who lives under the depot platform ramp.
animals.notes: Reflective collar helps with visibility near the tracks.

animals.name: Sunny
animals.description: Sun-loving ginger who stretches out on the bandstand steps.
animals.notes: Loves a chin scratch, will follow you home if allowed.

animals.name: Poppy
animals.description: Playful youngster who chases leaves along the playground fence.
animals.notes: High energy. Wand toys keep her out of the road.

animals.name: Tofu
animals.description: Deaf white cat who reads hand signals and follows the kiosk queue.
animals.notes: Deaf - approach from the front so he sees you coming.

animals.name: Ziggy
animals.description: Wild-looking Bengal mix who treats every tree as a ladder.
animals.notes: Stays high when startled - food on the branch stump works.

animals.name: Maple
animals.color: Long red-brown coat with a bushy tail
animals.description: Fluffy giant who sleeps in the maple shade by the picnic tables.
animals.notes: Big appetite - double portions agreed with the station volunteers.

animals.name: Bandit
animals.color: Grey tabby with a black mask patch
animals.description: Masked tabby who raids the recycling bins at the depot at dawn.
animals.notes: Keep lids on the bins or he will scatter everything.

animals.name: Willow
animals.description: Soft-voiced persian mix who lives beneath the weeping willow by the canal.
animals.notes: Flat-faced - wipe her eyes weekly and use shallow bowls.

animals.name: Tux
animals.description: Dapper tuxedo boy who poses on the market crates like he owns them.
animals.notes: Loves being photographed, tolerates gentle handling.

animals.name: Cinnamon
animals.color: Warm cinnamon brown with cream belly
animals.description: Soft cinnamon tabby who hides behind the market flower stall.
animals.notes: Sneezes in pollen season - keep her away from the lilies.

location.label: Behind the flower stall, Market Alley

animals.name: Sage
animals.color: Pale sage-grey with pale green eyes
animals.description: Quiet silver cat often mistaken for a garden statue in the herb beds.
animals.notes: Does not mind being near people, just keeps her distance politely.

animals.name: Barnaby
animals.description: Calm older terrier who waits calmly at the west gate for his walkers.
animals.notes: Wears an old red fabric collar. Waits at the gate instead of following people.

animals.name: Rufus
animals.description: Hungry chocolate lab who patrols the north fence line every morning.
animals.notes: Very food motivated. Two scoops max - he will act like he has never eaten.

animals.name: Juno
animals.description: Alert shepherd mix who guards the bandstand stage doors.
animals.notes: Barks at cyclists. Approach slowly and let her sniff your hand first.

animals.name: Baxter
animals.description: Nose-down beagle who works the picnic tables for leftovers.
animals.notes: Follows his nose into the picnic area - use small, frequent portions.

animals.name: Nala
animals.color: Grey and white with ice-blue eyes
animals.description: Husky mix on a skin treatment plan, waiting for a foster placement.
animals.notes: Medicated rinse every 10 days. Never let her drink from the duck pond.

animals.name: Otis
animals.color: Tan and white, long droopy ears
animals.description: Slow-moving senior hound who naps in the shade of the basin benches.
animals.notes: Short walks only. He drinks more than he eats, so the basin bowl matters most.

animals.name: Winnie
animals.color: Red and white with a fluffy rump
animals.description: Short-legged corgi mix who herds the pigeons away from the feeding station.
animals.notes: Guards the station bowl - feed her first and she will let the others eat.

animals.name: Bruno
animals.color: Black and tan with a broad chest
animals.description: Gentle giant living in the builders yard behind the depot fence.
animals.notes: Gentle with known volunteers, needs a calm voice and no sudden moves.

animals.name: Sadie
animals.color: Black and white with a split face
animals.description: Toy-obsessed collie mix who will trade a fetch game for dinner.
animals.notes: Needs ten minutes of play before eating or she ignores the bowl.

animals.name: Cooper
animals.description: Soft-mouthed golden mix who carries a tennis ball everywhere he goes.
animals.notes: Middle-aged with stiff hips - soft bedding and a raised bowl help.

animals.name: Daisy
animals.color: Liver and white with feathered ears
animals.description: Young spaniel mix who bounces through the long grass chasing insects.
animals.notes: Still learning not to jump up - feed from a flat hand.

animals.name: Gus
animals.description: Retired racer who sleeps standing up and only wakes for dinner.
animals.notes: Thin skin and thin coat - he needs a padded bed and a warm spot.

animals.name: Rocco
animals.color: Fawn with a white chest and a docked tail
animals.description: Boxer mix with a healing jaw wound, on soft food and pain relief.
animals.notes: Wound checked by the vet van on Tuesdays. Soft food and small portions only.

animals.name: Lola
animals.description: Small fluffy girl who rides in the market trolley when her paws get cold.
animals.notes: Coat mats quickly - brush twice a week or book a groom.

animals.name: Scout
animals.color: Blue speckle with a black patch
animals.description: Speckled cattle dog pup who tries to herd the park pigeons and fails.
animals.notes: Needs daily exercise or he digs. Very trainable with treats.

animals.name: Moose
animals.color: Solid black with a white bib
animals.description: Enormous gentle newfie mix who drinks a full bowl at every visit.
animals.notes: Needs a shaded bowl - he overheats quickly and empties it within minutes.

location.label: Boat house shade wall, South Basin

animals.name: Thistle
animals.description: Domestic rabbit abandoned in the herb beds - cannot survive a winter outdoors alone.
animals.notes: Domestic rabbit - must not be released. Hay first, never bread or lettuce.

location.label: Under the herb bench, Community Garden

animals.name: Bramble
animals.color: Agouti brown with a pale belly
animals.description: Young agouti rabbit living in the meadow bramble thicket with Thistle.
animals.notes: Bonded with Thistle - keep the pair together if a foster home is found.

animals.name: Kiwi
animals.description: Cage-trained cockatiel dumped near the pier, now using the hanging feeder.
animals.notes: Whistles at the ferry horn. Millet and seed in the hanging feeder only.

animals.name: Pip
animals.description: Guinea pig left in a cardboard box by the boathouse wall.
animals.notes: Needs fresh greens for vitamin C every day - without it he gets sick fast.

location.label: Crate by the boat house wall

activity.note: fed Milo with warm broth & kibble
left a pouch under the bandstand stage
eye wipes and a shallow bowl swap
flagged the injured front leg for the vet van
